featured.name: TheF CMS
featured.title: TheF CMS
featured.subtitle: An agentic CMS behind our agency's own Astro website – own platform, built end to end
featured.summary: Editors describe changes in natural language and an agent edits the site's Astro pages – or edit content directly on a live preview. Each editing workspace lives on its own git branch with a disposable runtime; publishing squash-merges back onto the production branch and rebuilds the static site.
highlights: The site itself is the CMS: agents edit real Astro content blocks, not a database.
Per-editor git-branch workspaces with disposable, auto-reaped runtimes – losing a runtime loses nothing, the branch is durable.
Editing surface built on SolidJS, orchestrated by a SolidJS control-plane dashboard.
featured.cta: In active development – demo on request

featured.name: enterprise-analytics-platform
featured.title: Enterprise analytics platform
featured.subtitle: Built for a Gulf-based national AI company – client anonymised
featured.summary: A production platform for a national AI company, shipped against an extremely tight deadline using AI-assisted development: AI at the keyboard to move fast, with architecture, review and quality owned at senior level.
highlights: From kickoff to production on an aggressive deadline – the pace is visible in the commit graph, with the build concentrated in weeks.
A Radix UI component system, auth, validated forms with zod, and CMS-driven content on the Next.js app router.
